name: Hayabusa Mk.I Torso
desc: Dad's custom core. Rebuilt, patched, and uniquely tuned.
flavor: It groans when you start the reactor, but it always starts.

name: Hayabusa Left Arm
desc: Stripped-down manipulator arm. Fast but fragile.
flavor: The servo whines a bit when you raise the fist.

name: Hayabusa Right Arm
desc: Stripped-down manipulator arm. Fast but fragile.
flavor: Wrapped in thermal tape to hide the weld marks.

name: Hayabusa Legs
desc: High-mobility chassis legs. Perfect for sprinting through narrow scrapyard alleys.
flavor: They look like they belong on a racing rig, not a scrapper.

name: Sora C-100 Core Module
desc: Mass-produced civilian torso. Thin armor, light weight, decent cooling. Every delivery pilot in New Tokyo has worn one.
flavor: The Sora logo is stamped on the inside. Nobody sees it but you.

name: KZ Industrial Torso Mk.I
desc: Standard dockyard labor torso. Built to carry cargo, not win fights. But cargo doesn't shoot back.
flavor: Built for dockyard labor. Ugly, heavy, nearly indestructible.

name: RC Patchwork Torso
desc: Red Creek special. Three different torso shells welded together into something that technically functions.
flavor: No brand. No warranty. No consistency. All heart.

name: Sora M-300 Core Module
desc: Upgraded civilian torso with reinforced cockpit housing. Still mass-produced, but built for the premium market.
flavor: Sora calls this their professional line. Professionals call it adequate.

name: KZ Dockyard Torso Mk.II
desc: Reinforced industrial torso with double-plated reactor housing. The welding is ugly, but it holds.
flavor: KZ quality control: if it doesn't fall apart when you kick it, it ships.
notes: Upgraded KZ. Higher HP/armor but traps heat (+2).

name: DW-X5 Thermal Core
desc: Daewon advanced cooling torso. Integrated heat sink network drops operating temperature by 15%.
flavor: The internal temperature readout displays to two decimal places. Daewon engineers care about those decimal places.
notes: Best heatMod at tier 2 (-8). Tech over tank.

name: AT-440 Patrol Core
desc: Aegis-Tac standardized patrol torso. Reliable, unremarkable, exactly as specified.
flavor: The inspection sticker is still on the inside. Last certified six months ago.

name: Paradox Core
desc: Phantom Works experimental torso with regenerative nano-layer. Slowly repairs itself, but armor is paper-thin.
flavor: The nano-layer smells like ozone and bad decisions.

name: DW-X9 CryoCore
desc: Daewon flagship torso. Liquid nitrogen cooling loop. Temperature stays below ambient under sustained fire.
flavor: Frost forms on the outer plates during combat. Pilots say it's beautiful.

name: Type 88 Fortress Core
desc: Kuroda military-grade torso with layered composite armor and shock-absorbing cockpit cage.
flavor: The ejection system has three redundancies. Kuroda assumes the worst.

name: Sora C-100 Manipulator
desc: Civilian-grade arm unit. Basic servos, basic grip, basic everything.
flavor: Sora's cheapest arm. Grips cargo. Grips weapons. Grips onto hope.

name: Drone Manipulator Arm
desc: Precision arm from a survey drone. Excellent fine motor control. Terrible at punching things.
flavor: Originally designed to handle sensor equipment. Now it handles weapons. Poorly.

name: KZ Hydraulic Press Arm
desc: Industrial hydraulic arm designed for cargo manipulation. The grip strength can crush steel pipe.
flavor: It was designed to move shipping containers. Nobody asked what happens when it grabs a person.
notes: Durable early-game arm. 2 integrity at tier 1.

name: RC Cobbled Arm
desc: Red Creek arm from three different donor units. The elbow is Sora. The shoulder is KZ. The hand is unknown.
flavor: It twitches sometimes. That's normal. Probably.

name: Sora M-300 Servo Arm
desc: Upgraded civilian arm with reinforced joints and improved actuator response.
flavor: Now with 30% more joint warranty coverage. Terms and conditions apply.

name: KZ-7 Reinforced Arm
desc: Uparmored industrial arm. Extra plating welded over the hydraulics.
flavor: The original arm was fine. KZ's solution to every problem: weld more steel on it.
notes: Tankiest arm at tier 2. 40x2=80 HP. Armor 5.

name: AT-220 Patrol Arm
desc: Police-issue arm with stabilized weapon platform. Designed for accurate fire during pursuit.
flavor: The stabilizer gyroscope hums when active. Some pilots find it calming.

name: DW-N3 Neural Interface Arm
desc: Daewon experimental arm with neural-link weapon integration.
flavor: The neural feedback is... intimate. Some pilots love it. Others vomit.

name: Glitch Arm
desc: Phantom Works prototype with embedded EMP burst emitter.
flavor: The wiring looks wrong. The circuits look wrong. It works anyway.

name: Type 44 Assault Arm
desc: Kuroda military-grade arm with integrated recoil compensation and armored weapon housing.
flavor: The maintenance manual is 300 pages. The field strip instructions alone are 40.

name: Sora C-100 Leg Unit
desc: Civilian-grade legs designed for urban commuting. Light, fast, not built for combat.
flavor: Top speed: 85 km/h on paved road. Combat speed: please don't.

name: KZ Labor Hydraulic Legs
desc: Industrial legs built for carrying heavy loads. Slow, stable, supports twice their weight.
flavor: Rated for 40-ton cargo loads. Your frame weighs a lot less than that.
notes: Solid medium-compat legs. 2 integrity at tier 1.

name: RC Sprinter Legs
desc: Red Creek custom legs built for scrapyard racing. Light, fast, held together with hope.
flavor: They call it the Sprinter because running away is a valid survival strategy.
notes: +1 initiative. Cheapest legs with a special.

name: Sora M-300 Leg Unit
desc: Professional-grade legs with shock-dampened joints and improved terrain handling.
flavor: The suspension was designed for luxury civilian models. It works in combat too.

name: KZ-7 Heavy-Duty Legs
desc: Uparmored industrial legs with doubled hydraulic actuators.
flavor: KZ engineering: if it's not heavy enough, you're not trying hard enough.

name: AT-330 Pursuit Legs
desc: Aegis-Tac patrol legs optimized for sustained urban pursuit.
flavor: Rated for 12-hour continuous patrol. Most fights last 12 minutes.
notes: Best medium legs for sustained combat. Heat -3.

name: DW-H2 Hover Actuators
desc: Daewon hover-capable legs. Magnetic levitation. Incredibly light, incredibly fragile.
flavor: They don't touch the ground. Amazing engineering or safety violation. Daewon says both.

name: Ghost Step Legs
desc: Phantom Works prototype with sound-dampened actuators. Near-silent movement.
flavor: You can't hear them coming. You can hear them leaving. Barely.

name: Type 66 Assault Legs
desc: Kuroda military-grade legs with triple-layered knee armor.
flavor: The knee joints were tested by dropping a 10-ton weight on them. They passed.

name: Extra Coolant Tank
desc: Auxiliary coolant reservoir. Extends heat capacity by 15 points.
flavor: Just a bigger radiator. Simple solutions are the best solutions.

name: Ammo Crate
desc: Reinforced ammunition storage. Adds 5 Supply at mission start.
flavor: More bullets. The answer to most problems in the scrapyard.

name: Field Repair Kit
desc: Automated repair drone. After combat, restores 10 HP to most damaged part.
flavor: The drone is the size of a cat. It sounds like an angry cat, too.
notes: 10 HP post-combat. Great for Light frames.

name: DW-S3 SenseGrid
desc: Daewon multi-spectrum sensor suite. Enhances targeting algorithms.
flavor: It sees in infrared, ultraviolet, magnetic, and seventeen spectrums humans can't pronounce.

name: DW-C1 Neural Dampener
desc: Daewon stress-reduction system. Filters neural feedback to reduce pilot anxiety.
flavor: It doesn't make you brave. It makes you too numb to be afraid. The difference matters.

name: TY-C3 Thermal Regulator
desc: Taeyang active cooling system. Increases heat capacity AND accelerates dissipation.
flavor: Taeyang builds the hottest weapons. Of course they build the best cooling too.
notes: +25 heatCap AND +2 dissipation/turn. The definitive thermal solution. Taeyang manufactured â€” they understand heat better than anyone. Enables aggressive energy weapon builds. Pairs with Neural Override maneuver for 'heat monster' builds. Heavier than Sora Coolant Tank (4 vs 3) â€” tradeoff for Light frames.

name: Type 77 Munitions Bay
desc: Kuroda military ammunition system. High-capacity magazine with auto-feed mechanism.
flavor: The loading mechanism was designed for sustained siege operations. Your scrapyard fights are a vacation by comparison.
notes: +10 Supply (double the basic crate) AND 15% supply efficiency. Medium/Heavy only â€” too heavy for Light. Military rep gate. Turns Heavy frames into sustained-fire platforms. Combined with Ammo Conservation maneuver, ballistic weapons become nearly infinite.

name: NanoForge Repair Drone
desc: Autonomous repair unit with nanomaterial reserves. Repairs during AND after combat.
flavor: The drone rebuilt half a torso in twelve minutes. Then it billed you for the materials.
notes: 25 HP post-combat (2.5Ã— basic kit) AND 2 HP/turn regen during combat. The 'never stop fighting' utility. Sora's civilian engineering applied to battlefield repair. skill_mecha_tech gate ensures the pilot can maintain the complex drone. Regen stacks with Emergency Repair maneuver for serious sustain.

name: PW-X1 Ghost Scanner
desc: Phantom Works prototype sensor suite. Classified detection algorithms that shouldn't exist on the civilian market.
flavor: The serial number is filed off. The firmware is encrypted. It works better than anything legal.
notes: +10 accuracy (double SenseGrid), +1 initiative, AND reveals enemy part HP at combat start. Phantom Works origin â€” illegal, powerful, rare. Exile rep + hacking skill gate. Lightest advanced utility (2 weight). The Tactician's dream backpack. Stacks with System Scan maneuver for total battlefield awareness.

name: AT-NR Neural Regulator
desc: Aegis-Tac neural feedback suppressor. Military-grade stress management for extended operations.
flavor: Corporate pilots use these for 18-hour patrol shifts. You'll use it to not lose your mind in a 3-minute fight.
notes: -0.5 stress/turn (2.5Ã— the basic dampener), +10 stress cap, AND +5 panic threshold. Aegis corporate origin â€” they keep their pilots calm through chemistry, not courage. Police rep gate (Aegis supplies law enforcement). Combined with Iron Will maneuver, the pilot is nearly unbreakable mentally.

name: RC-OC Overclock Module
desc: Red Creek aftermarket power booster. Dumps raw energy into all systems. Side effects include overheating, stress, and voided warranties.
flavor: The label says 'NOT FOR COMBAT USE.' Someone crossed it out and wrote 'ESPECIALLY for combat use.'
notes: +1 ATK, -1 DEF, +3 heat/turn, +0.1 stress/turn. The Red Creek special â€” cheap, dirty, effective. No requirements. Available from minute 1. Pure aggression tradeoff. Pairs with Berserker Protocol (more stress = more ATK). The 'scrapyard kid who doesn't care about safety' backpack. Cheapest advanced utility at 12 creds.

name: Arena Broadcast Rig
desc: Portable camera and signal booster. Broadcasts your fights to the arena network. More spectacle, more glory.
flavor: The camera adds ten pounds. The glory adds ten thousand fans.
notes: +20% glory from ALL combat (not just arena). Available after Arena Registration story mission. Municipal origin â€” the city profits from broadcasting fights. Light weight, no combat stats. Pure economy item. The player trades a utility slot for faster glory progression. combatLogDetail flag means more detailed combat log entries.

name: DW-E7 ECM Suite
desc: Daewon electronic countermeasures. Jams enemy targeting systems and scrambles incoming missiles.
flavor: The enemy's targeting computer says you're three meters to the left. You're not.
notes: -8 enemy accuracy AND 15% chance to intercept missile/shoulder weapons. Defensive electronic warfare. Daewon's sensor expertise inverted â€” instead of seeing better, you make the enemy see WORSE. Stacks with Suppressing Fire maneuver's SUPPRESS tokens for serious accuracy denial. Hacking + combat skill gates ensure the pilot understands electronic warfare.

name: AT-SV Salvage Analyzer
desc: Aegis-Tac battlefield salvage system. Scans defeated enemies for valuable components during combat.
flavor: It catalogs every piece that falls off the enemy. By the time the fight ends, your shopping list is ready.
notes: +25% loot quality (higher chance of finding equipped parts instead of generic scrap) AND +15% bonus scrap from combat. The farming backpack. Aegis corporate â€” they recover and resell everything. skill_gathering gate ties it to the scavenging loop. Competes with Broadcast Rig for 'economy slot' â€” glory vs loot.

name: Hayabusa Auxiliary Core
desc: A secondary power core from the Hayabusa project. Boosts all frame stats at the cost of extreme heat generation.
flavor: Dad's notes say: 'Core output exceeds projections by 340%. Cooling solution: TBD.' He never solved it. Maybe you can.
notes: +2 ATK, +1 DEF, +2 ENR â€” massive stat boost. But +8 heat/turn AND +0.3 stress/turn. Cannot be bought â€” only found in Dad's Secret Lab after the final story mission. Light/Medium only (Dad built it for the Hayabusa). The ultimate risk-reward backpack. Requires TY-C3 Thermal Regulator or Coolant Flush maneuver to manage the heat. Value 0 = cannot be sold. The player keeps Dad's legacy.

name: DW-A1 Battle Analyzer
desc: Daewon combat telemetry suite. Records, analyzes, and learns from every engagement. Accumulated knowledge translates to faster pilot growth.
flavor: It watches you fight, then tells you everything you did wrong. Constructive criticism from a machine.
notes: +15% glory AND +20% combat experience from all fights. The farming utility. Doesn't help you WIN fights â€” helps you GROW from them. Lightest T3 utility (2 weight). For players who want to accelerate progression over raw combat power.

name: TY-X Plasma Capacitor
desc: Experimental Taeyang energy storage unit. Captures waste heat and converts it to weapon energy. The hotter you run, the harder you hit.
flavor: The containment warnings flash every three seconds. You stopped reading them after the first hour.
notes: +15 heatCap AND converts heat above 50% to +1% damage per heat point. At heat 80/100, that's +30% damage. Stacks with Neural Override maneuver (which adds +2% per point above 75). The 'burning build' cornerstone. Dual gate: military rep 2 + skill_combat 5.

name: Type 90 Siege Module
desc: Kuroda's bunker-class defensive suite. Deploys reinforced plating and shock absorbers. The frame becomes a fortress â€” immobile, immovable, immortal.
flavor: Movement speed drops to zero. Incoming damage drops to almost zero. Acceptable trade.
notes: +25% DEF, -0.3 stress/turn, +2 armor to ALL parts. But -3 initiative (always acts last) and 15 weight. Heavy-only. The ultimate tank utility. Combined with Fortress Protocol + Defensive stance, the frame takes single-digit damage from most attacks. Requires rep_military 3 â€” deep military relationship.

name: PW-0 Ghost Module
desc: Phantom Works signature technology. Sensor-baffling countermeasures, heat masking, and active camouflage. You're not invisible â€” you're just not where they think you are.
flavor: Serial number: [REDACTED]. Manufacturer: [REDACTED]. How did you get this: [REDACTED].
notes: 10% evasion, +2 initiative, +3 accuracy, heat signature masking (enemies less likely to target you first). Light-only, 1 weight. The assassin utility. Combined with Ghost Step legs (evasion 5%) and Wraith frame, total evasion reaches 15% â€” one in seven attacks miss completely. Phantom Works origin, exile rep gated.

name: DW-X Synapse Bridge
desc: Daewon's experimental direct neural interface. Bypasses manual controls entirely â€” the pilot IS the frame. Faster, stronger, sharper. The headaches are a small price.
flavor: The pilot's brainwaves control the frame directly. The frame's damage feedback reaches the pilot directly. Nobody said the bridge only goes one way.
notes: +10% all stats AND +5 accuracy. But +0.3 stress/turn AND 1.5Ã— damage-to-stress conversion. The pilot feels everything the frame feels â€” amplified. Extremely powerful with Iron Will + Neural Dampener to manage the stress. The endgame 'glass brain' utility: maximum performance, maximum psychological cost.

name: Gyro-Stabilizer Boots
desc: Calibrated weights and sensors that improve stance stability.
flavor: The gyro hums at a frequency that, after a while, feels like a heartbeat.

name: Armored Skirts
desc: Extra plating attached to the lower chassis to protect the joint systems.
flavor: Extra steel on the hips. Inelegant. Effective. The two are not mutually exclusive.
